timing: Recorded before inspecting BridgeRNA gene-attribution results
gene_response: mean IG over held-out flight chips minus mean IG over held-out ground chips
robust_shortlist: Top100 by absolute response attribution in all four head/reference cases, same sign in all four, sign retained in >=90% of 24 single-held-out-chip deletion contrasts
rank_comparison: Spearman on all15137 observed genes; top100 overlap across references/pools and versus expression
pathways: All50 predefined Hallmark sets, signed sum and mean absolute gene response attribution. Descriptive, overlapping associations; not activation or enrichment p-values.
perturbation: Top25/100 per-sample absolute IG versus20 training-expression-mean/SD-matched random panels; replacement by primary training-ground reference; top-only TPM-renormalization sensitivity reported separately
